nodes.description: Private address state variable in Ownable holding the current owner; read by owner() and written by _transferOwnership().
IERC20 state variable fixed at 0x8400D94A5cb0fa0D041a3788e395285d61c9ee5e; target of the external transfer call in withdraw().
Context internal helper returning msg.sender; used for ownership initialization and authorization checks.
View function returning the _owner state variable; used by the onlyOwner modifier.
External function guarded by onlyOwner that sets the owner to address(0) via _transferOwnership().
External onlyOwner function validating a non-zero newOwner and forwarding it to _transferOwnership().
Internal function that reads old _owner, writes the new owner and emits OwnershipTransferred.
Main entry point of ProvideNetworkValidatorLicense: onlyOwner external function that transfers `amount` tokens to the caller.
Access control modifier requiring owner() == _msgSender(); applied to withdraw, renounceOwnership and transferOwnership.
Caller-controlled address; compared against owner in onlyOwner and used as the recipient of the withdrawn tokens.
External call token.transfer(msg.sender, amount) whose return value is required to be true; transfers value to the caller.
uint256 parameter of withdraw() specifying the token amount sent to msg.sender.
address parameter of transferOwnership() checked against address(0) and forwarded internally.
address argument of the internal _transferOwnership() assigned into the _owner state variable.
Local address variable in _transferOwnership() caching the previous _owner for the OwnershipTransferred event.

edges.reason: owner() reads the _owner state variable and returns it.
onlyOwner compares owner() with the caller derived from _msgSender(); caller identity drives the authorization check.
onlyOwner calls owner() and requires it to equal the caller, enforcing the ownership restriction.
The onlyOwner modifier gates execution of withdraw(), restricting it to the contract owner.
The onlyOwner modifier gates renounceOwnership(), restricting it to the contract owner.
The onlyOwner modifier gates transferOwnership(), restricting it to the contract owner.
renounceOwnership() calls _transferOwnership(address(0)) to clear the owner.
transferOwnership() calls _transferOwnership(newOwner) after validation.
The newOwner parameter of transferOwnership() is validated against address(0) and forwarded.
The validated newOwner value flows into _transferOwnership() as the new owner.
The newOwner argument of _transferOwnership() is assigned into the _owner state variable.
_transferOwnership() reads the current _owner into the oldOwner local before overwriting it.
_transferOwnership() writes the new owner address into the _owner state variable.
The oldOwner local variable is emitted in the OwnershipTransferred event from _transferOwnership().
The constructor passes _msgSender() as the initial owner into _transferOwnership().
The token state variable is the external contract on which transfer() is invoked.
msg.sender is passed as the recipient of token.transfer(), so caller-controlled input reaches the value transfer.
The amount parameter of withdraw() is passed directly as the transfer amount.
msg.sender is the recipient used inside withdraw(), linking caller input to the function's token payout.
withdraw() executes the external token.transfer call inside a require that enforces a true return value.
The external token.transfer call hands control to an external contract and its return value is required; any re-entrant callback would execute while withdraw() is still on the stack.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter is a non-core node whose only use is as the value argument of the withdraw() external token.transfer call; it can be normalized into that unsafe_operation.
The newOwner parameter is a non-core node fully consumed by transferOwnership() validation and forwarding; it can be normalized into that function.
The internal newOwner argument exists only inside _transferOwnership() where it is assigned to _owner; it can be normalized into that function.
The oldOwner local variable is a transient cache used only by _transferOwnership() for the OwnershipTransferred event and can be normalized into that function.
